title: Surreal Mechanical Face
description: A large circular mechanical head dominates the center, divided into segmented panels with visible text including 'TODAY', 'INJECT', and 'INDECISION'. The lower portion features a grotesque screaming mouth with sharp teeth, while the left side displays a large golden eye with gears. A rusty multi-pointed star protrudes from the right side against a swirling cosmic sky with two moons.
